column2: Tournament organization: the Magic Tournament Rules (an external document) add rules and card restrictions for sanctioned events. The engine models the game, not tournament policy; the in-game consequences it names (game-loss penalties, intentional draws, matches) are covered by 104.3k, 104.4i and 100.6a.
Informational: where to find tournaments (the Store & Event Locator website). No game behavior.

Informational: some casual/un-set cards (playtest, silver-bordered, acorn) have features outside the Comprehensive Rules. It states no rule the engine could apply; those cards simply aren't modeled beyond their oracle text.
